name: slide-metadata
body: Per-slide metadata derived at render time, never authored: number (the 1-based position of the current slide in the deck's presentation order — its slide file's place in the flattened slide order) and total (the number of slide files in the deck). Exposed to layouts and section templates under the reserved `slide` context (template-context). Distinct from authored slide frontmatter (fields) and from domain.value.slide-position (the filename-derived number/letter/label).
